_comment: Phase-1 contacts fixture for the blinker-platform domain SDK. Conforms to canon/blinker-domain.json `contact` shape (validated by scripts/validate-fixtures.js). Migrated from mission-control/src/fixtures/contacts.json (Wave 18) and expanded with 9 new contacts that exercise: opp-less, vehicle-less, no-VIN, no-mileage, household, and per-workflow status resume points.
_household_clustering: hh_alvarez_brooks: Maria Alvarez + Tasha Brooks (mother + adult daughter). hh_morgan_family: Casey + Jordan Morgan (spouses, same address). hh_patel_family: Avery + Deepa Patel (spouses, same address; both in org 103). hh_vasquez_family: Elena + Marco Vasquez (spouses, same address; both in org 102). hh_oduya_family: Grace Oduya (org 103) + Felix Oduya (org 102) — cross-org household (mother in different dealer relationship than adult son). Wave 26a fu4 expansion added 5 household clusters.
_vehicle_arrays: Maria Alvarez has 2 vehicles to exercise the array; rest have 0 or 1. Each vehicle.id is referenced by the corresponding opportunity in opportunities.json (vehicle_id linkage will be added there in a later canon expansion).
_test_case_principle: Each contact carries an optional `_test_case: <slug>` annotation describing what scenario it exercises (vehicle-without-vin, no-opps, household-do-not-call, …). Underscore prefix means validate-fixtures.js treats it as meta. AgentInbox + AgentContacts render `_test_case` as a tooltip on the Type/Name pill ONLY when the active org has `test_mode: true`. A future `org.demo_mode` flag will replace the gate when prototype → dev → prod branches diverge.
